## Review Summary — Drawer Organizer Tray Maker (`index.html`)

### Application Status: **PASS** ✅

The single self-contained `index.html` fulfills all original requirements:

| # | Requirement | Verified |
|---|-------------|----------|
| 1 | Default 180×120×30 mm, 3×2 grid — state & HTML values match exactly | ✅ |
| 2 | Editable outer dimensions (width/depth/height) with sliders + number inputs, live bindSync update | ✅ |
| 3 | Editable row/column counts (colsSlider/rowsNum, min/max constraints) | ✅ |
| 4 | Editable wall & floor thickness (range 1-10 mm, step 0.5) | ✅ |
| 5 | Compartment dimensions display with correct formulas (`innerW=outerW-2wt`, `perW=(innerW-(nc-1)wt)/nc`, etc.) | ✅ |
| 6 | Volume in **mL** correctly computed as `mm³/1000` (the previous bug was already fixed) | ✅ |
| 7 | Rotatable 3D WebGL preview — mouse drag, touch, scroll zoom, reset camera | ✅ |
| 8 | Solid + wireframe view modes with separate shader programs, edge extraction | ✅ |
| 9 | Binary STL export — correct format (84B header, per-facet normal via cross product, vertices offset by box position, little-endian) | ✅ |
| 10 | Tray geometry: floor plate + 4 walls + (nc-1) vertical dividers + (nr-1) horizontal dividers | ✅ |
| 11 | Edge case guards (`Math.max(0,...)` on all inner dimensions) | ✅ |
| 12 | Self-contained offline — no external CDN, fonts, or stylesheets | ✅ |

### Review JSON
Written to `.ralph/review.json` with `passed: true`, all 12 checks passing, empty failures array. The volume bug flagged in the prior review (`kind: "application"`) has been resolved in the current source — `/1000` is present on both `innerVol` (line 305) and `totalVol` (line 306).
